experiences.title: 想提前离开
experiences.summary: 在“想提前离开”中练习“有其他安排”相关的英语交流。

experiences.summary: 在“想提前离开”中练习“不舒服 / 不想继续待”相关的英语交流。

scenarios.title: A｜普通聚会
scenarios.setting: 玩家参加朋友的聚会，待了一段时间后准备回家。

turns.text: Hey, I think I’m going to head out.

turns.prompt: 你想说明想提前离开的原因，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, I’m getting a little tired.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I’m getting a little tired.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

choices.text: I’ve had a great time, but I think I’m going to call it a night.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve had a great time, but I think I’m going to call it a night.
feedback.explanation: “I’m going to”说明计划或去向，能让对方知道接下来的安排。

choices.text: I should probably get going. I’ve got an early morning tomorrow.

feedback.naturalExpression: I should probably get going. I’ve got an early morning tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: “get going”表示动身离开，是结束闲聊时常用的说法。

choices.text: I think I’m ready to head home. Thanks for inviting me!

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I’m ready to head home. Thanks for inviting me!
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I want to leave now.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I’m getting a little tired.
feedback.explanation: “I want to leave now”强调自己想走；普通聚会告辞可以先感谢招待，再说需要离开。

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks for having me. I had a really good time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for having me. I had a really good time.
feedback.explanation: “thanks for having me”感谢对方邀请或招待自己，适合做客后的告别。

choices.text: Of course. I’m glad I came.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. I’m glad I came.
feedback.explanation: “I'm glad”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: Thanks for inviting me. We should do this again sometime.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for inviting me. We should do this again sometime.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

turns.text: Definitely. Text me when you get home.

turns.prompt: 你想友好地结束这段交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: Will do. Have a good night!

feedback.naturalExpression: Will do. Have a good night!
feedback.explanation: “will do”简短表示会照办，适合接到明确任务后回应。

choices.text: I will. See you soon!

feedback.naturalExpression: I will. See you soon!
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: B｜有其他安排
scenarios.setting: 玩家来参加了朋友的活动，但之前已经告诉对方自己不能待太久。

turns.text: We’re thinking about going somewhere else after this. Are you coming?

turns.prompt: 你想礼貌说明自己不接受或不方便，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’d love to, but I have somewhere else I need to be.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d love to, but I have somewhere else I need to be.
feedback.explanation: “I’d love to”热情表示愿意或很想做某事，后接动词原形。

choices.text: I can’t, unfortunately. I’ve already made plans for later.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t, unfortunately. I’ve already made plans for later.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: I wish I could, but I have another commitment tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wish I could, but I have another commitment tonight.
feedback.explanation: “another commitment”说明已有约定或责任，用来解释不能继续留下而不必透露细节。

choices.text: I can stay for another twenty minutes, but then I’ll have to go.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can stay for another twenty minutes, but then I’ll have to go.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: I have another arrangement, so I need to leave.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’d love to, but I have somewhere else I need to be.
feedback.explanation: “another arrangement”偏书面；日常说“I have other plans”更常见。

turns.text: No worries. What time do you need to leave?

turns.prompt: 关于「想提前离开」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: I should probably leave around eight.

feedback.naturalExpression: I should probably leave around eight.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I need to be there by eight thirty, so I’ll head out soon.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need to be there by eight thirty, so I’ll head out soon.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: In about fifteen minutes. I just wanted to stop by and see everyone first.

feedback.naturalExpression: In about fifteen minutes. I just wanted to stop by and see everyone first.
feedback.explanation: 先报离开时间，再说明想顺道见见大家；“stop by”表示短暂拜访。

turns.prompt: 你想表达认同或相似的感受，会怎么说？

choices.text: Me too. I didn’t want to miss it completely.

feedback.naturalExpression: Me too. I didn’t want to miss it completely.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: Of course! I just wish I could stay longer.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course! I just wish I could stay longer.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: We’ll have to hang out properly another time.

feedback.naturalExpression: We’ll have to hang out properly another time.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

scenarios.title: C｜不舒服 / 不想继续待
scenarios.setting: 聚会还在继续，但玩家感觉状态不太好，决定提前离开。

turns.text: Hey, you’re pretty quiet. Everything okay?

turns.prompt: 关于「想提前离开」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, I’m okay. I’m just not feeling great, so I think I’m going to head home.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I’m okay. I’m just not feeling great, so I think I’m going to head home.
feedback.explanation: “I’m going to”说明计划或去向，能让对方知道接下来的安排。

choices.text: I’m feeling a little off tonight. I might call it a night.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m feeling a little off tonight. I might call it a night.
feedback.explanation: “I might”表示一种可能的计划，还未完全决定。

choices.text: I’m fine, just really tired. I think I’d rather head home.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m fine, just really tired. I think I’d rather head home.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: It’s been a long day, and I don’t really have the energy to stay much longer.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s been a long day, and I don’t really have the energy to stay much longer.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: This party is making me uncomfortable. I want to leave.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I’m okay. I’m just not feeling great, so I think I’m going to head home.
feedback.explanation: 若确实感到不适，这句可以清楚表达；只是普通告辞时，简短致谢并说明要离开即可。

turns.text: Oh, okay. Do you need anything?

turns.prompt: 你想说明暂时只需要休息，会怎么说？

choices.text: No, I’m okay. I think I just need some rest.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, I’m okay. I think I just need some rest.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Thanks, but I’ll be fine once I get home.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks, but I’ll be fine once I get home.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: I appreciate it. I just don’t feel like staying out any longer tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate it. I just don’t feel like staying out any longer tonight.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: No, but thanks for asking.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, but thanks for asking.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

turns.text: Okay. Let me know when you get home.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: I will. Thanks for understanding.

feedback.naturalExpression: I will. Thanks for understanding.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Sure. Sorry I’m leaving early. I’ll see you soon.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Sorry I’m leaving early. I’ll see you soon.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Thanks. I still had a nice time—I just need to get some rest.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I still had a nice time—I just need to get some rest.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。
